dataset.discovery_notes: Selected from HF Hub search of 40 'ffhq' candidates. merkol/ffhq-256 chosen for: (a) exactly 256x256 PNG, (b) clean schema with single 'image' field, (c) confirmed 70000 train samples in dataset card, (d) parquet format, (e) sha stable since 2023-08-28.

cross_validation_mirror.note: Independent mirror confirms ~29.6 dB is SD-VAE-ft-mse limit, not mirror artifact
